0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Gryllos is cursing up a storm.

27.original: While transfigured, speak with the slippery mandragora.

48.original: Crows take that little sod! Where's it gone n─ Oh! I was unaware we had a visitor.

49.original: Pardon my language─I should hate to give a poor impression of Elpis with my unprofessional behavior. Alas, I am quite at my wits' end with this new cultivar. You are fortunate not to have overheard worse.

50.original: Its restorative properties are superlative, that much is true. Yet what possessed its creator to give it such nimble little legs, I shall never understand. I really must impress upon those fools at the Words of Halmarut that not <hex:021A020203>everything<hex:021A020103> need be ambulatory!

51.original: I have tried leashing it, fencing it in, staring at it with all my might...each to no avail. Its resourcefulness is far beyond what one could─and I daresay <hex:021A020203>should<hex:021A020103>─wish of a vegetable.

52.original: Given that it shows such signs of sentience, however...perhaps it is possible for another intelligent creation to commune with it. Are you willing to make the attempt?

53.original: When it embarked upon its most recent bid for freedom, I sent my assistant after it. His own legs have grown quite powerful by this point, so with any luck, you will find them not too far to the west.

54.original: At this rate, we will certainly succeed at filling this star with life─but at what cost?

56.original: Gryllos sent you to “commune” with the mandragora? Er...best of luck.

57.original: I assure you that it will respond if you speak to it. I cannot promise you will enjoy the experience, however...

59.original: The mandragora emits a screech not unlike the sound of a magitek airship's hull rending in twain, but it is unclear what this is meant to convey.

61.original: So even its fellow creations cannot understand it─what a pity. Granted, I did suspect its vocal organ was...unique.

62.original: Aha! If you took the same form, that may be less of an obstacle.

63.original: Though I am admittedly unversed in the original design specifications, I should have little difficulty transforming you into its mirror. Shall we have a go?

65.original: In order to proceed further in the quest, you must be under the transfigured status.

66.original: Should you accidentally remove your transfiguration, speak to Gryllos's assistant to be transfigured once more.

67.original: Yes, it is quite flattering on you. Now please, commune with the mandragora.

68.original: Odd... I would not have expected the magic to dispel so soon. Never you mind, though─there is more than enough where that came from.

70.original: The mandragora emits a screech not unlike the sound of a magitek airship's hull rending in twain, but it is unclear what this is meant to convey.

72.original: If anything, you understand even less than you did before.

73.original: How was that? ...Ah, one moment please.

75.original: Pardon me─I had not the slightest idea what you were saying. Would you mind repeating that?

76.original: Foiled again! Nevertheless, we have gained valuable data.

78.original: Alas. Please inform Gryllos that it may be some time before I return...

80.original: Seemingly incapable of comprehensible communication, is it? Perhaps its degree of intelligence bears further scrutiny.

81.original: Of course, if upon further observation it <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> deemed sentient, it will be subject to even greater scrutiny to ensure that it can be safely set loose.

82.original: To understand each creation in all its aspects, and conclusively prove it beneficial or detrimental to the star─such is our duty and burden as researchers...

83.original: ...At least we can say with certainty that its legs work.
